description:
Upload a CSV for bulk email validation.
When to use: When the user wants to start a new bulk validation job from list data.
Parameters: fileContent — CSV text; fileName — e.g. list.csv; hasHeaderRow (optional); emailAddressColumn — 0-based column of the email addresses; optional firstNameColumn, lastNameColumn, genderColumn, ipAddressColumn, removeDuplicate, allowPhase2, returnUrl.
WRITE: Changes ZeroBounce account data (uploads, deletes, filters, tests, batch validation, warmup settings). Confirm with the user before calling.
CREDITS: Each successful call spends ZeroBounce account credits. Confirm with the user before calling unless they explicitly asked for validation, enrichment, or activity data.

allowPhase2.description: Whether to allow phase 2 processing (sent as allow_phase_2). Sent only when given.

emailAddressColumn.description: Column index (0-based) containing email addresses. Defaults to 0 (first column).

fileContent.description: CSV file content as a string

hasHeaderRow.description: Whether the first row of the file is a header row. Sent as false when not given.

removeDuplicate.description: Whether to remove duplicate emails (sent as remove_duplicate). Left out, it is sent as false.

returnUrl.description: Optional HTTPS callback URL when processing completes. Only use trusted URLs you control; an attacker-controlled URL can receive bulk results.

name: send_file
title: Upload file for validation
